She approached the project with a meticulous eye for detail, ensuring that every space was thoughtfully planned and beautifully executed.

Each room reflects a perfect blend of elegance and functionality. The living area feels spacious yet inviting, the bedrooms exude comfort with a touch of sophistication, and the kitchen has been designed for both efficiency and style. The cohesive design elements tie the entire flat together, creating a harmonious ambience that elevates the overall living experience.

Execution was handled with remarkable precision. Timelines were strictly adhered to, quality standards were consistently maintained, and every aspect of the project was supervised with professional diligence. Anmol’s ability to translate our requirements into a refined and sophisticated living environment has exceeded our expectations in every way.

Beyond her technical expertise, what truly sets Anmol apart is her dedication and client-centric approach. She listened carefully to our preferences, offered innovative solutions, and ensured that the final outcome reflected not just her design sensibility but also our personality and aspirations.

We confidently recommend Anmol for her outstanding design sensibility, flawless project management, and unwavering commitment to excellence. Her work has transformed our flat into a residence of distinction — a home that is both functional and breathtakingly beautiful, one we are proud to call our own.

name: SJK Architects
description: SJK Architects is an architecture, interior design and master planning practice founded in 1990 by Shimul Javeri Kadri, and led by her and Partners, Vaishali Mangalvedhekar, Sarika Shetty and Roshni Kshirsagar. They design spaces for a rapidly urbanising India, meticulously crafted from a study of climate, culture, history, and technology – each unique to the place and its people. A Mumbai-based collective of 30+ built environment professionals, they work with clients and collaborators all across the country.

owner_posts.post_text: Bold yet understated, SJK Architects’ design for the flagship store of Forest of Chintz in Mumbai brings alive India’s glorious, ancient stepwells. The restrained material and colour palette inspires an almost cavernous retail experience – providing a suitable backdrop for the label’s exuberant collections and facilitating an intimate rendezvous with the visitors.

The Resort Hotel in Bodh Gaya uses the power of memory and emotion to create immersive architecture that embodies the tenets of Buddhism. The 78-key hotel Spread over 5-acres responds to the religious tourism in the region - designed as an ode to the historical roots of Buddhism in India.

The SR University started in 2001 as an engineering college campus on the outskirts of Warangal on a 28-acre plot of land and has developed gradually, one building at a time, based on a master plan that totals to around 5.11 lakh sqft.
The “box” for Nirvana emerged, as with all urban buildings, out of a small corner plot in the heart of the busy neighbourhood of Indiranagar in Bengaluru.
